info.title: Omni-Folio Core API
info.description: Minimal cross-runtime contract for trust status, CSV import, deterministic portfolio snapshots, explicitly labeled sample market data, sanitized ledger activity, stored broker reconciliation, and verified local order lifecycle reads. JSON decimals are canonical strings; IDs are opaque strings.

get.description: Read persisted preferences and stored-price states. Reject every query including bare ?. No provider/network refresh. Browser Origin must exactly match configured origin, or be absent for native/local clients. Private service profile only; CORS is not authentication.

200.description: Current saved list with independently unavailable quote rows.

503.description: watchlist_unavailable: fixed redacted error; no partial response

post.description: Explicit whole-list CAS replacement; does not mutate ledger, prices, listing authority or orders. Reject query, non-JSON content, oversized body, duplicate JSON keys and invalid entries before mutation. One SQLite transaction, exact row count and stored-state readback before commit. Returns state-only ACK without performing a post-commit price read. Uncertain transport/5xx/malformed ACK retains the original expected_revision and entries for explicit retry/reload. A reload at a greater revision fences that original CAS; at the same revision only identical desired entries reconcile it. A lower revision must not acknowledge it. App-session pending intent is not durable across app restart.

200.description: Exact stored state; new revision, unchanged no-op, or duplicate acknowledgement.

400.description: watchlist_invalid: this attempt rejected before commit

403.description: watchlist_origin_rejected: this attempt rejected before handler

409.description: watchlist_changed: this CAS attempt did not commit; reload current list

503.description: watchlist_unavailable: commit outcome uncertain; retain intent

get.description: Compares stored KRW/USD normalized index versions with the same retrospective TWR period and knowledge cutoff. Native and KRW views remain independent when FX is missing. Query parameters, including an empty query marker, are rejected. Read only; no provider calls or market authority claim.

200.description: Same-period comparisons or explicit missing/unsupported inputs, with TWR preserved.

500.description: Durable proof or internal validation failed; redacted error.

get.description: Reads retrospective whole-portfolio cumulative TWR in one verified read transaction. Restates cash corrections; groups external cash before internal events at each exact UTC timestamp. Uses historical local prices and direct FX with separate economic and report knowledge cutoffs and a24h age policy. Nonpositive intermediate capital and ambiguous split units are unavailable. No annualization, broker calls or writes; query parameters rejected.

200.description: Cumulative calculation, empty or unavailable; private identifiers omitted.

500.description: Durable proof or internal validation failed; fixed redacted error.

get.description: Reads effective external deposit/withdrawal flows and current whole-portfolio valuation in one schema/transition/ledger/observation-verified read transaction at one server cutoff. Uses stored local observations only; no writes, credentials or broker calls. Query parameters are rejected. Does not compute TWR or benchmark performance.

200.description: Unique calculation, non-unique-possible candidate, empty or unavailable report; private identifiers omitted.

500.description: Durable proof or internal validation failed; fixed redacted error.

get.description: Returns the latest REGISTERED research artifact by registry sequence, including no_promotion, not the selected strategy or newest wall-clock time. No query parameters are accepted. One database read snapshot validates registry hash/metadata and public shape/bindings without recomputing reported metrics. The reader supports only long_only_sma_crossover 1.0.0, canonical UTC timestamps and the documented numeric caps; the existing writer is unchanged. Unsupported or corrupt newest artifacts fail without falling back to an older report. No source/account IDs, hashes, traces, raw JSON, provenance freshness, live state or execution authority are exposed.

200.description: Stored research artifact, or report=null when no REGISTERED artifact exists.

500.description: Storage failed or the newest registered artifact is unsupported or corrupt; only generic redacted internal_error details are returned, with no partial result or fallback.

get.description: On-demand, replay-verified local fixture policy observations across all paper accounts. No query parameters, broker requests, financial metrics, process-liveness claim or execution authority. Response is no-store; no monitoring write or renewal occurs.

200.description: One verified database snapshot.

500.description: Recovery or storage failed; no partial result.

200.description: Process is healthy.

get.description: Checks that the process can read the migrated database schema required to serve ledger requests.

200.description: Database is reachable and schema version is supported.

503.description: Database is unavailable, unmigrated, or on an unsupported schema.

200.description: Current local-ledger validation state. This does not claim reconciliation with a broker. Phase A never enables live trading.

get.description: Returns current remaining FIFO quantity and cost plus the latest 50 original BUY/SELL records for one exact instrument and currency in one verified ledger revision. Aggregates all imported accounts. Average cost is display-only half-even rounding to eight decimal places, not tax basis or a broker price. Trades exclude corporate actions and are not broker-confirmed executions; has_more means older matching trades were omitted. No candle join or historical price adjustment is implied. Only instrument_id and currency are accepted, each exactly once.

parameters.name: instrument_id
parameters.description: Exact opaque instrument ID already supplied by the portfolio snapshot; never derive identity from the display symbol.

200.description: One current local-ledger observation. A previously traded but now closed holding has quantity/cost 0 and null average; original trades remain.

404.description: No BUY/SELL record for the exact instrument/currency, including dividend-only instruments.

500.description: Ledger verification failed; details are redacted.

get.description: Returns explicitly configured local-fixture OHLCV data only. It never represents live or broker data. symbol and interval must each appear exactly once; unknown query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Local sample bars. price_adjustment=unspecified, source=local_fixture, sample=true, and state=stale are contractual disclosures, not live-market freshness claims.

404.description: The configured local fixture has no matching symbol and interval.

500.description: The configured market-data adapter violated the normalized-series contract.

503.description: No market-data fixture was configured at service startup.

get.description: Returns one directly stored local-fixture FX observation at or before as_of. The direction is exact: rate is quote-currency units per one base-currency unit. No inverse, cross, interpolation, FX_EXCHANGE inference, valuation, or live-freshness claim is provided.

200.description: A directly observed local sample with stale/sample provenance.

404.description: No eligible observation exists for the exact source, direction, and cutoff.

500.description: Stored observation state failed canonical validation.

get.description: Values only the current replay-verified ledger cash into the requested base currency under direct_fx_cash_v1. It uses exact cash-currency to base-currency observations only, never inverse/cross/FX_EXCHANGE inference or rounding. Missing or over-age pairs suppress the aggregate. Local fixture results remain sample/stale and whole-portfolio valuation remains unavailable.

200.description: A deterministic cash-only result with exact coverage and selected-observation provenance.

409.description: The requested valuation cutoff predates the current replayed ledger state.

500.description: Ledger or FX durable state failed replay, canonical hash, or timestamp validation.

get.description: Read-only holdings-only valuation using the current replay-verified ledger and stored local fixture prices in one read transaction. Defaults to server UTC now; explicit as_of must be canonical UTC and cannot predate the current ledger or be in the future. Exact decimal values are grouped by native currency without FX conversion. Any missing, ambiguous, or over-24-hour price suppresses all totals. Selected prices remain sample/stale, never live. Internal instrument and observation IDs are omitted. Unknown, duplicate, empty, and malformed query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Sanitized valuation with ledger revision and selected-price provenance. Empty and unavailable results have null totals; stale_sample requires every line to be valued and totals grouped by native currency.

409.description: The valuation cutoff predates the current ledger state; retry against the server clock.

500.description: Ledger or stored price replay validation failed; internal details are not returned.

get.description: Values the replay-verified whole portfolio in KRW at one server-owned UTC cutoff and one read transaction. Cash and current holding market values use only exact direct local-fixture FX and stored local-fixture security prices no older than 24 hours. Any missing, stale, or ambiguous required observation suppresses every aggregate. This is indicative sample data, not broker truth, live pricing, cost basis, PnL, or performance.

200.description: A closed all-or-none KRW aggregate bound to its ledger revision and server cutoff.

400.description: The endpoint does not accept query parameters.

500.description: Ledger, FX, or security-price durable state failed replay or canonical validation.

get.description: Returns the latest stored Kiwoom KRX position-quantity reconciliation. This is historical evidence with freshness=unverified; it does not refresh the broker, represent current state, or reconcile cash, valuation, fees, orders, or executions. Account references, internal IDs, hashes, and the raw snapshot are never returned.

200.description: Sanitized latest stored reconciliation bound to its ledger revision.

500.description: The newest stored snapshot or reconciliation failed canonical hash, metadata, or completeness validation.

get.description: Replays the append-only local order log without calling a broker or verifying current broker state. The response excludes account, client-order, provider-order, execution, reservation, strategy-authority, and fencing identifiers. It is display-only and provides no submit, retry, cancel, or other mutation action.

200.description: Newest-first local order lifecycle records, or an empty orders array when none exist.

500.description: A stored order intent or event failed canonical validation or replay.

get.description: Returns a replay-verified, newest-first page of sanitized local ledger events. This does not call or refresh a broker, prove current broker state, value the portfolio, or expose a mutation action. Internal event, source, account, instrument, receipt, correction-target, and sequence identifiers are omitted.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to the ledger revision of the first page. The current local profile may invalidate it on service restart.

200.description: A complete local-ledger page, including an empty events array when no transactions exist.

500.description: The local ledger failed canonical validation or deterministic replay; no partial page is returned.

post.description: Parses and validates raw CSV text without writing to the ledger. Rejects input over 1 MiB (1048576 bytes) or 10000 data rows. The preview fingerprint binds file hash, schema version, mapping version, and ledger revision.

schema.description: UTF-8 CSV text, limited to 1048576 encoded bytes and 10000 data rows excluding the header.

200.description: Read-only row classification and totals.

post.description: Atomically applies an applicable preview. Repeating the same idempotency_key with the same payload returns the original receipt. Reusing that key with a different payload returns 409.

200.description: Original or replayed atomic apply receipt.

409.description: The idempotency key was already used with a different payload, or the preview ledger revision is stale.

value.message: idempotency_key was already used with a different payload
ledger revision changed; create a new preview

200.description: Deterministic ledger snapshot. It does not claim live market valuation.

post.description: Stateless input-only review using the existing strict file decoder; no database admission, currentness or storage claim. Exact input echo correlates the captured request, not an independently verified canonical hash. No query (including an empty ?). Raw UTF-8 JSON <=1MiB. Browser Origin, when present, must be exactly the configured origin; no-Origin native/local requests remain allowed under the existing single-owner boundary, not authentication. Preview response <=6MiB+16KiB; Cache-Control: no-store.

200.description: Input-only metadata with exact raw text.

500.description: owner_data_unavailable — unresolved storage outcome; retry immutable original.

post.description: Explicit atomic storage using the existing importer and native receipt. Same identity/version/payload returns its original receipt before reading the record clock; old retries do not reactivate versions. A failed/lost response may follow commit. Once uncertain, retain the same raw request until a matching receipt resolves it, even after a later 4xx. No query (including an empty ?). Raw UTF-8 JSON <=1MiB. Browser Origin, when present, must be exactly the configured origin; no-Origin native/local requests remain allowed under the existing single-owner boundary, not authentication. Preview response <=6MiB+16KiB; Cache-Control: no-store.

200.description: Stored native receipt; not provider certification or proof of latest active version.

500.description: owner_data_unavailable — unresolved storage outcome; retry immutable original.

get.description: Read the existing TWR calculation checkpoints without changing scalar/benchmark policy. No query, including an empty ?. Flow points neutralize external capital before internal events at the same timestamp; the terminal includes all events. Selected marks may precede boundary time by up to24hours under the existing policy. No provider/credential/network/write or new history table. One deposit yields only start+terminal points, not daily performance. Encoded response <=3MiB and Cache-Control:no-store.

200.description: One coherent aggregate report and bounded checkpoint trace.

500.description: Stored input/proof/cancellation/transport or internal trace bound could not be confirmed; fixed public error.

WatchlistEntry.description: Owner-entered watch preference only. Does not verify listing existence, grant broker capture authority, create a holding, or admit owner price input.

WatchlistState.description: One mandatory mutable singleton, independent of the ledger. Canonical tuple-sorted entries; revision zero only with null updated_at and empty entries. Every changed list advances revision once; no-op keeps it. Revisions are not a cross-backup-restoration epoch.

WatchlistChange.description: At most16KiB UTF-8; unknown, duplicate/escaped duplicate keys, null values, invalid identity and duplicates are rejected. Input order is canonicalized. Compare-and-swap against expected_revision. Same current list at expected revision is a no-op; same list at expected+1 acknowledges a retry. Any other stale revision conflicts. No implicit retry; retain exact intent after uncertain responses.

WatchlistPrice.description: Exact native-currency saved price only. observed_at <= fetched_at <= recorded_at <= report observed_at. Source version is at most128 UTF-8 bytes with no whitespace/control. Never a broker/live quote or valuation.

WatchlistQuote.description: Identity must equal its same-position watchlist entry. Missing/ambiguous have null price. Fixture always stale/sample. Owner price is unknown through exactly24h, stale thereafter: unknown never means current-market verified. Ambiguous identity or tied latest timestamp with different displayed provenance has no chosen price. Ignore Kiwoom sources, future observations and other tuples; choose latest whole owner version before tuple filtering, preserving withdrawal/venue changes.

WatchlistReport.description: One transaction and server cutoff captured after transaction acquisition; one quote per entry in identical order, no private/account/observation IDs. updated_at is not after observed_at. Independent row absence/ambiguity preserves other rows, while stored proof corruption fails the entire response. Transport/parser failure retains the whole prior report and original cutoff; successful missing replaces old price. Encoded response at most128KiB.

PortfolioBenchmarks.description: One read transaction and one server clock. All stored benchmark versions are proved, including when TWR is unavailable. Select maximum append sequence per ID whose recorded_at is no later than the report cutoff. No cross-version endpoint mixing, holiday interpolation, inverse FX or provider calls. More than32 eligible IDs returns no index rows and benchmark_limit while preserving TWR. Without owner security prices, v2 derives FX authority from selected FX mark provenance or the nested portfolio notice, including partial/stale marks. Selected owner security prices use v3, deriving the nonblocking price notice from the nested portfolio. Top-level issues remain list failures only; sample follows the selected series/FX sample declarations.

anyOf.description: Exact difference of the published portfolio TWR and published KRW benchmark rate, times100; unit is percentage points. Not alpha or cost-adjusted excess performance.

PortfolioBenchmark.description: One selected complete version. KRW native and KRW results are identical with no FX marks. USD native and KRW are independent; missing FX never erases a valid native rate. Actual selected observation timestamps may differ from the economic boundaries by at most24h for calculated views.

storage_check.description: Stored integrity only; not provider/market authority.

benchmark_id.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

label.description: At most 160 UTF-8 bytes, trimmed and without control characters.

source_reference.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Public provenance reference only; never fetched by this command. No credentials, query or fragment.

source_version.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

level.description: Nonnegative canonical decimal; zero start is unavailable, zero terminal may represent total loss.

rate.description: Positive direct USD to KRW rate selected by the same economic/report cutoffs. Local fixture provenance remains sample even if the other endpoint is missing or stale.

source_version.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

BenchmarkFXMark.description: Two-field legacy marks mean local fixture/sample=true. Owner v2 marks explicitly contain source, immutable source_version and independent sample; unknown/null/partial provenance is invalid. Both endpoint marks for a pair use one whole version.

anyOf.description: Published fractional rate, 12dp half-even, at least -1. Zero is a calculated value, never missing input.

rate.description: Published fractional rate, 12dp half-even, at least -1. Zero is a calculated value, never missing input.

PortfolioTWR.description: Since-inception retrospective KRW cumulative TWR, not annualized. Restated external cash groups precede internal events at each exact UTC timestamp. Links asset values immediately before external groups to previous post-flow capital, then terminal value to last positive capital. Requires positive intermediate capital; a full withdrawal is unavailable, not a total loss. Historical prices and direct FX observed by each boundary and fetched/recorded by report cutoff must be <=24h old; split marks must be strictly after the last applied split. Final cash and quantity maps and terminal total reconcile to the proved current ledger. Exact rational products are rounded once to12decimals, with8192bit product and1000boundary budgets. Missing or unsupported inputs never become0percent; no trading no-lookahead or PP daily-convention equivalence claim. Without selected owner security prices, selected owner FX uses v2. owner_declared_fx is non-blocking provenance, independent of sample_data, and remains visible for stale/unavailable results. Pair inputs use one latest-known complete version at report cutoff; a missing point never falls back to an older version. Owner security price selection uses v3 with one nonblocking owner_declared_price notice and optional independent owner_declared_fx notice.

PortfolioXIRR.description: Since-inception retrospective KRW XIRR. Exact event conversion before UTC-date aggregation; actual/365 and twelve-decimal numerical output. Annual rate only for one sign change; nonconventional converged values are candidates without certified uniqueness. Missing observations or numerical failures never become zero. Cash voids remove the original external flow. Historical FX observed_at <= event occurrence, fetched/recorded <= report cutoff; <=24h economic age. This is not a trading no-lookahead policy. Without selected owner security prices, selected owner FX uses v2. owner_declared_fx is non-blocking provenance, independent of sample_data, and remains visible for stale/unavailable results. Pair inputs use one latest-known complete version at report cutoff; a missing point never falls back to an older version. Owner security price selection uses v3 with one nonblocking owner_declared_price notice and optional independent owner_declared_fx notice.

metrics_verification.description: Stored reported metrics are shape/binding validated, not recomputed from source bars.

observed_at.description: Server UTC observation time, captured once for this read in canonical RFC3339Nano form.

StoredResearchReport.description: Latest registered artifact, including failed promotion. fast_window must be less than slow_window; displayed windows identify only the final candidate evaluated on the final holdout, not each walk-forward fold's independently selected candidate. A paper_candidate label is research evidence and grants no execution authority.

recorded_at.description: Canonical UTC RFC3339Nano registration time; registry sequence determines latest even if the wall clock regresses.

failed_gates.description: Unique failed gates in fixed walk_forward, final_holdout, buy_and_hold_baseline order; empty exactly when promotion_target is paper_candidate.

walk_forward.description: Each fold independently selects its candidate. Reported after_cost_return is the arithmetic mean across folds, max_drawdown is the maximum, and round_trips is the sum.

holdout.description: Reported final candidate metrics on the final_holdout span.

buy_and_hold.description: Modeled buy-and-hold on the same final holdout span with the same cash, quantity, fees and delayed-fill model; not raw market return.

ResearchReportRange.description: Final holdout bar range; first_bar_at must be at or before last_bar_at. The timestamps are equal exactly when bar_count is 1.

after_cost_return.description: Reported signed return ratio; no magnitude bound is imposed.

max_drawdown.description: Reported canonical nonnegative drawdown ratio; fixed fees can make this exceed 1.

observed_at.description: Server UTC observation time, captured once for this read.

strategy_selected.description: Registry has a selected candidate; this grants no execution authority.

pending_policy_count.description: All committed valuations without a completed attribution/policy chain, including prior selections. Not runnable queue depth or missing source data.

PaperMonitorRunner.description: Global policy-runner lease only, not the separate execution lease. Precedence: unowned, clock_regressed, expired, selection_changed, lease_recorded. Expired does not imply takeover readiness. Times are null only when unowned.

PaperMonitorPolicy.description: Most recently appended policy across all local paper accounts, not necessarily the current strategy or newest market time. A rollback normally makes matches_current_selection false. HOLD is a modeled historical decision, not current safety or profitability. Wall-clock regression may put recorded_at before as_of; consumers must not impose monotonic wall-clock ordering.

OpaqueId.description: Opaque identifier. Consumers must not parse or order it.

Decimal.description: Canonical base-10 decimal string: no exponent, leading plus/zero, trailing fractional zero, or negative zero.

OccurredAt.description: When the economic event occurred at its source.

ReceivedAt.description: When Omni-Folio received the apply request; this is not the source event time or durable commit time.

RecordedAt.description: When Omni-Folio durably recorded the ledger mutation.

LedgerActivityTimestamp.description: Canonical UTC RFC3339 timestamp used by the verified local ledger.

live_enabled.description: Phase A is read/import only; live trading is disabled.

trust_state.description: Validation state of the local imported ledger only; verified does not mean broker-reconciled.

last_verified_at.description: Time of the last successful atomic import and local ledger-invariant validation. Null when trust_state is never_verified; never a broker-reconciliation timestamp.

MarketDataCandles.description: instrument_id and currency are either both null (legacy unknown) or both explicitly declared by the source for every bar. They are not inferred from the query, symbol, current listing, or selected holding. The client compares both to the selected holding before accepting an identified series. bar_time_basis=unspecified means at is only a timestamp label, not a proven session date, start, close, or trade-to-bar membership. It cannot authorize ledger overlays.

instrument_id.description: Explicit fixture instrument ID; server also enforces <=128 UTF-8 bytes and no whitespace/control characters.

rate.description: Exact quote-currency units per one base-currency unit.

source_version.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

CashValuationFX.description: Legacy fixture fields stay unchanged. Declared source_version identifies one whole owner FX version; sample is its independent declaration. unknown means no provider freshness certification; line status separately enforces the24h age limit, and genuinely old selected marks are stale.

ledger_recorded_at.description: Current ledger metadata recorded time, including duplicate-only imports; not the last event timestamp. Valuation cutoff must cover this metadata and every event recorded time in the proved revision.

CashValuation.description: Without selected owner security prices, selected owner FX uses v2. owner_declared_fx is non-blocking provenance, independent of sample_data, and remains visible for stale/unavailable results. Pair inputs use one latest-known complete version at report cutoff; a missing point never falls back to an older version.

source_version.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

HoldingValuationPrice.description: Owner unadjusted is a unit declaration, not provider verification. Owner marks require source_version. Observation age and split basis are checked independently.

ledger_recorded_at.description: Current ledger metadata recorded time, including duplicate-only imports; not the last event timestamp. Valuation cutoff must cover this metadata and every event recorded time in the proved revision.

HoldingValuation.description: Owner provenance is nonblocking and sample is independent. Nonsample owner marks can produce complete; unavailable totals remain null and split_basis retains the selected mark.

ledger_recorded_at.description: Current ledger metadata recorded time, including duplicate-only imports; not the last event timestamp. Valuation cutoff must cover this metadata and every event recorded time in the proved revision.

CurrentPortfolioValuation.description: Without selected owner security prices, selected owner FX uses v2. owner_declared_fx is non-blocking provenance, independent of sample_data, and remains visible for stale/unavailable results. Pair inputs use one latest-known complete version at report cutoff; a missing point never falls back to an older version. Owner security price selection uses v3 with one nonblocking owner_declared_price notice and optional independent owner_declared_fx notice.

broker_quantity.description: Canonical non-negative quantity from the stored broker snapshot.

ledger_quantity.description: Canonical non-negative quantity replayed from the bound ledger revision.

match.description: True exactly when difference is zero.

freshness.description: The endpoint returns stored evidence and does not verify current broker state.

symbol.description: Display label from the current holding, or the latest returned trade when closed; individual original trade labels may differ.

ledger_as_of.description: Latest event occurrence in this entire ledger revision, not only this instrument.

ledger_recorded_at.description: Recorded time of the last appended event in this revision, not the last duplicate import or the maximum wall-clock time. Earlier events may have later recorded times after a clock adjustment.

average_cost.description: Current remaining FIFO cost including allocated buy fees divided by split-adjusted current quantity, half-even rounded to 8 decimals for display only. May be 0 for a tiny positive cost; null only when quantity is 0. Never use the rounded value to recompute ledger cost.

has_more.description: A 51st matching BUY/SELL record exists in this revision. No total count or completeness beyond this bound is claimed.

trades.description: Only BUY/SELL of the exact instrument/currency, original values, descending occurred_at nanoseconds then append sequence. SPLIT and all other activity types are excluded.

amount.description: Exact signed cash effect; this is not a base-currency valuation.

counter_currency.description: Non-null only for FX_EXCHANGE and always distinct from currency.

counter_amount.description: Positive exact bought amount for FX_EXCHANGE; it is not a quoted or current exchange rate.

is_correction.description: True only for CASH_VOID. The correction target identifier is intentionally omitted.

amount.description: quantity times price minus fee; zero and negative net proceeds are valid.

broker_freshness.description: This read does not refresh a broker or prove current broker state.

mode.description: Local execution mode, not a Kiwoom mock or production environment claim.

filled_quantity.description: Canonical non-negative quantity replayed from local events.

pending_action.description: Command still unresolved in the verified local replay, or none. This is not current broker state and contains no identifier.

last_recorded_at.description: Timestamp of the newest local append-only order event, not a broker observation time.

broker_freshness.description: This read does not refresh the broker or prove current broker state.

amount.description: Signed net cash impact of the event, including fees.

counter_currency.description: Required only for FX_EXCHANGE; the distinct currency bought by the atomic exchange.

counter_amount.description: Required only for FX_EXCHANGE; the positive exact cash amount bought. It does not imply a quoted or current exchange rate.

corrects_source_event_id.description: Required only for CASH_VOID and identifies the same-account source event being exactly reversed.

correction_target.description: Present for CASH_VOID rows so clients can disclose the preserved original without internal event identifiers.

preview_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON containing file_sha256, schema_version, mapping_version, and ledger_revision. Apply must reject a changed binding.

can_apply.description: False when any row is error or unresolved; preview never mutates the ledger.

cost_basis.description: Remaining FIFO acquisition cost, including allocated buy fees.

cost_basis_policy.description: Events replay in exact canonical UTC nanosecond order, with sequence breaking timestamp ties. A partial FIFO lot keeps an exact finite decimal allocation; only a recurring proportional result is rounded half-even to at least 8 decimal places, or the current finite lot-cost scale when greater. The residual remains with the open lot and is consumed exactly when it closes. This analytical policy is not a jurisdictional tax-basis claim.

as_of.description: Latest occurred_at included in this ledger snapshot.

valuation_status.description: No live price source is part of this slice.

realized_pnl.description: FIFO realized profit/loss net of allocated buy fees and sell fees.

OwnerPriceIdentity.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, without Unicode whitespace or control characters.

OwnerPriceTimestamp.description: Canonical UTC RFC3339Nano; server rejects invalid dates.

OwnerFXIdentity.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, without Unicode whitespace or control characters.

OwnerFXTimestamp.description: Canonical UTC RFC3339Nano; server rejects invalid dates.

benchmark_id.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

label.description: At most 160 UTF-8 bytes, trimmed and without control characters.

source_reference.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Public provenance reference only; never fetched by this command. No credentials, query or fragment.

source_version.description: At most128 UTF-8 bytes, no Unicode whitespace or controls.

input.description: Exact valid UTF-8 request text, not reserialized JSON. At most 1048576 encoded bytes.
Exact valid UTF-8 request text, not reserialized JSON. At most 1048576 encoded bytes.
Exact valid UTF-8 request text, not reserialized JSON. At most 1048576 encoded bytes.

at.description: Evaluation boundary time, not the selected market price/FX observation time.

cumulative_rate.description: Canonical cumulative ratio >= -1; independently rounded from exact prefix to12places. Intermediate -1 may be rounding, not depleted capital. Prefix length is independent of the scalar final128char bound.

PortfolioTWRCheckpoints.description: One server cutoff/read transaction. Calculated: exactly boundary_count external_flow points followed by one valuation; first at=period_start/rate0, last at=period_end/rate=report.cumulative_rate. Flow times strictly increase in UTC nanoseconds. Only final flow and valuation may share a timestamp, in that order. Noncalculated reports have no partial prefix. Authority/sample apply to the entire observation. No daily path or interpolation claim.
